results.title: Pakistan will remain major security concern, threat for times to come: ex-CDS Gen Anil Chauhan
results.description: Former CDS Gen Anil Chauhan has raised concerns regarding Pakistan's possible overconfidence stemming from new defense agreements. He emphasized that Pakistan continues to pose a serious security threat to India. Strategies like Operation Sindoor are part of India's efforts to drive behavioral changes in Pakistan. The stability-instability paradox underpins Pakistan's reliance on proxy warfare and terrorism, necessitating India to uphold strong deterrence across all fronts to thwart these dangers.
